title: Have you seen a reception hall/ballroom/dining ball?
content: The place is sort of weird and I wouldn't know the real name for it, but its like a low drop ceiling, long room with a bunch of round tables and metal chairs. Almost like a reception hall? There are almost no lights and no candles or anything so its always dark and sort of dingy in there and everyone is sitting and just talking with each other. I go hop around tables and speak to multiple different groups but none of them really seem to be interesting so I keep looking for my table full of friends. There are no doors or openings, its like we are just sealed into this dark long meeting hall.
